description:
Register a BNS domain name in a single transaction using name-claim-fast. This is the RECOMMENDED method — no preorder/register wait needed. Burns the name price in STX and mints the BNS NFT atomically. Works for all open namespaces (BNS V2).

Tip: call `earning_opportunities` to see how to put your assets to work.

sendTo.description: Optional recipient address. Defaults to the wallet's own address.

name: claim_bns_name_fast
